news.title: Speaker Johnson: 'Confident' government shutdown will end by Tuesday
news.description: The government shut down on Saturday after Senate Democrats demanded changes to a spending package following the killings of U.S. citizens in Minnesota.

news.title: Epstein files: Ro Khanna says DOJ's latest release is 'not good enough'
